_info: Config for epo_fetch_events.py. Keys starting with _ are comments. Backslashes must be doubled: DOMAIN\user
_epo_url: Address of the ePO server incl. port (normally 8443)
_username: ePO account with permission to run queries against Threat Events. Domain account: DOMAIN\user
_password_b64: Password of the ePO account, base64 encoded. Create with: ./epo_fetch_events.py --encode-password  or  echo -n 'MyPassword' | base64 . Protect the file with chmod 600 (base64 is not encryption)
_password_env: Environment variable read FIRST if it is set (takes precedence over password_b64 above). Plain text
_verify_tls: true = verify the ePO TLS certificate (recommended), false = do not verify (testing only)
_ca_cert: Path to the CA certificate (.pem) that signed the ePO cert. Empty = system CA store. Only used when verify_tls is true
_mode: events = all threat events (EPOEvents), extended = also hashes/paths/rules but only events with extended data
_start_index: First AutoID fetched on the very first run (when no state file exists)
_extra_where: Optional extra filter in ePO syntax, e.g. (eq EPOEvents.TenantId 1). Empty = no filter
_strip_table_prefix: true is required by the ArcSight parser (EPOEvents.ThreatName -> ThreatName)
_output_dir: Directory for the JSON files read by the ArcSight Folder Follower
_state_file: File where the last fetched AutoID is stored
_enrichment: Fields from ArcSight's ePO mapping that do not exist in EPOEvents
_server_host_name: Name of the ePO server -> Device Host Name. Empty = the host in epo_url
_server_ip_address: IP of the ePO server -> Device Address. Empty = resolved via DNS
_load_balance_http_port: -> Source Port. Empty = the event's own SourcePort is used
_enrich_systems: Fetch system properties per AgentGUID -> Old File ID/Name/Path/Permission/Type
_enrich_event_names: Fetch the event description per ThreatEventID -> Name. 0409 = English
_max_pages: Max number of pages per run, 0 = unlimited
